events.text: GM introduced the premise that the party were the police.
GM described Lieutenant Lavarsus's appearance.
Group gathered in Lavarsus's office to sign contract and receive badge and equipment.
Nadya entered the office late in an improperly worn uniform.
Lysandra watched from the window and shook her head at Nadya.
Nadya drank from a vial and complained about the windows.
Lavarsus lit his cigar while he awaited the rest of the group.
Lavarsus spoke of Korvosa with disdain.
Lieutenant Lavarsus put on coffee while awaiting the late captain.
The potfox made beverages for the group.
Zilde EvenGuard arrived late and apologized.
Lieutenant Lavarsus issued special magical badges that fine criminals.
Lieutenant Lavarsus warned the group not to misuse the badges.
Lieutenant Lavarsus ordered the group to go play bouncer at the tipsy tengu.
Nadya took a badge and stepped out to wait while the others exited the office.
Nadya complained about the office sunlight and offered treatment for bruises and scratches.
The group went to the tipsy tenth.
Zilde opened the door to the tipsy tenth and looked for the bar keep.
Lysandra stepped into the bar and looked for trouble.
Nadya offered an elixir to Pratchett.
Nadya addressed the ongoing disturbance theatrically.
The four adventurers calmed down and surrendered.
Nadya activated the badge and told the adventurers to leave.
Lysandra exited the Tipsy Tengu to report in.
The party arrived at the lieutenant's office.
Captain Acacia Uriana left.
Lieutenant Lavarsus told the party to head home.
Lysandra saluted and left the building.
Eclipsar saluted and left.
The party went to the Tipsy Tengus for free drinks and lodging.
Nadya drank and smoked leftover supplies.
Zilde went to the Lieutenant for more orders.
Sergeant Moldun Ollo greeted the group and checked badges.
Sergeant Moldun Ollo fell asleep mid-sentence.
Sergeant Moldun Ollo apologized for falling asleep.
Sergeant Moldun Ollo gave the party a marked patrol map.
Zilde took the map and thanked the Sergeant.
The party went out on patrol.
The party went to investigate a problem at the dockway.
Lysandra shouted for help and rushed to move barrels.
Lysandra carried a barrel away from hazard.
Nadya cast command on the closest fighting goblin.
Pelmo chanted bridge magic at Nadya.
Nadya demanded the goblins surrender so she could treat their burns.
The barrels were about to explode.
Zilde drowned the barrels in the horse trough.
Akuma arrived and said he was assigned to the unit.
Nadya treated the goblin with alchemy and offered flayleaf.
The party received 30 Gold Pieces and seized weapons and alchemist fires.
The group continued patrols across the lowcleft district.
A merchant yelled for guards to stop a fleeing woman.
Akuma attempted an Athletics check to block her path.
Combat began against the woman.
Nadya cast command to knock the thief prone.
Akuma critically slashed the thief with his katana.
Zilde struck the thief with her holy fire longsword.
The thief surrendered.
The merchant got his belongings back.
The group received 22 gold fined from the thief.
The party received a telepathic message about skeletons attacking dock workers.
The party rushed to the dock where skeletons attacked workers.
Gijō introduced himself on the way to the docks.
Nadya cast force barrage on a skeleton.
Lysandra slashed the remaining skeleton.
All skeletons were destroyed.
A firework spelling GUARDS appeared in the sky.
The party followed the fireworks to the magic shop.
Marin Porphyry scolded the party for taking so long.
Nadya called inside to talk to Eunice.
Eunice dropped his wand.
Sergeant Ollo ordered the party to handle escaped zoo creatures.
The party ran to the zoo.
The party arrived at the marketplace outside the zoo fence.
Changer introduced himself as a defence golem.
Gijō tripped the cockatrice.
Changer's device blasted the cockatrice for acid damage.
The cockatrice was beaten.
The party entered the snack shop and met Emmaline Greengold.
Hoots the Owlbear screeched.
Hoots struck Akuma for 5 damage.
Gijō tripped the owlbear.
The owlbear fell unconscious.
Akuma comforted the creature.
The party saw the black smith doors burst open from the shop.
The party recognized Rusty chewing on the metalwork.
Changer shot Rusty for 8 damage.
Akuma gored the creature with his horns.
Gijō ran up and grabbed the creature.
Nadya tried to daze the rust monster from range.
Rusty the Rust Monster fell unconscious.
Machiq reported his shop was destroyed and asked to file a report.
Machiq offered to guide the party to his store near the blacksmith's.
Lysandra drew her blades and headed toward the altercation sound.
Both hyenas were knocked unconscious.
The party learned something was happening at the Penguin exhibit.
The Magni Watch rushed to the penguin exhibit.
The penguin shrieked in primal terror.
Machiq tossed a rock into the water to attract the creature.
A giant viper lunged out of the water and bit.
Zilde knocked the viper unconscious.
The party received a hero point.
The party rushed past locked cages toward the next part of the zoo.
The party recovered coins, a short-sword, a dagger, rings and necklaces at the owlbear exhibit.
The Magni Stash total reached 92 gold.
The party rushed on.
The party entered the South Hall of the Zoo.
Machiq was left at dying 2.
The beetle was knocked out.
Akuma healed Machiq and struck the rabbit.
The party took a quick 10 minutes to rest.
Akuma picked up a horn that shaped into a katana and a club.
The party reached a room at the end of the hallway.
The party found frightened patrons and zookeepers huddled inside a cage.
Telomand and Raisa thanked the guards and introduced themselves.
Nil asked the party to find his son Jerov and handed over a photo.
Telomand listed the remaining areas left to check.
Lysandra said they needed to find and subdue the beast.
The party reached a locked office.
The party found keys for a wagon on the table.
The party found 5500 copper pieces in the drawer.
The party found an unsent letter ending the Knights marriage.
Akuma flipped the Bed switch.
Machiq pulled the lever again with Akuma on the bed.
Akuma described what he saw about a carriage outside
Lysandra said she would lead the way out to look for the ankhrav
Went outside and saw two wagons
Explored Minera Frum's wagon
Found Minera Frum's diary describing relationship with Mr Knight
Found healing potions and other creature care items in cupboards
Badges glowed and absorbed the items
Walked through the Rust monster exhibit
Saw dried blood
Saw sign for Rusty the Rust Monster
Kept going
Walked through the crystal ankhrav enclosure
Heard weeping behind a boulder
Saw the bastard burst from the ground
Ended combat
Learned the boy's name was Jerov and his father was Nils
Returned the boy to Nils and received 17 gold pieces
Found Remy the gnomish zoo keeper in the supply shed
Received 2 heavy crossbows with bolts from Remy
Saved the Magnimar zoo
Completed 5 percent of Magni Watch
Machiq said he would sue Remy
Summarized downtime plans for Nadya, Machiq, Gijo, Lysandra, Akuma and Zilde
Headed to the Arvensoar and found a dwarf asleep in the office
Trained together
Walked from the Arvensoar to the house
Arrived at the cosy stone house
Saw James Darkmoon reading a Cheliax-sealed letter
Met Sergeant Moldun Ollo
Met the hairy fetchling who drew a dagger in the den
Nadya shapechanged and explained the uniform
Took the lift down several floors
Entered the long thin stone room with figures on cushions
Shackle offered smoke, eat or inject
Nadya chose smoke
Nadya took a hit
Machiq left the office slamming the door
Learned Nadya had a letter
Nadya pocketed the envelope and described the experience
Nadya warned about the seal
Headed out to an empty spot and cracked the seal
Headed toward the Tipsy Tengu
Asked if everyone else was handled
Zilde said she would come too.
James told Zilde to stay and prepare and left the room and house.
James did not want Zilde to come with him.
Nadya encountered James while walking through the dockway.
James confirmed Nadya received her letter and told her to come with him.
Nadya greeted the captain and asked if she was needed now.
James fetched the others from the Arvensoar and walked to his house with the party.
James gathered the group and everyone reunited at Zilde's house.
James briefed the group on garden party security duty and guard uniforms.
Nadya fitted her ceremonial uniform in the armory and offered to help others.
James said the group needed more training and time.
James seemed satisfied the group was ready to go.
A carriage took the group up the seacleft cliff.
The group travelled across the city.
The group travelled to the Alabaster district.
The Magni Watch arrived at a large black and red manor house.
James gave patrol areas and check-in instructions.
Viole and the other Heroes of Magnimar appeared.
The group tried the unity tea at the Paracountess insistence.
Around 1,000 people collapsed with black and green veins spreading.
Viole and James cast something on the Magni Watch and they passed out alive.
The group awakened very sore.
The group found themselves in a stone room with a glass ceiling.
Koriah said they survived soul poisoning and Sister Miravelle prayed for just under 48 hours.
The elf introduced herself as Koriah Sunstrike.
Detective Desdelen Bolera introduced herself as investigating the party.
Akuma's green and black mark changed towards fiery red and dark blue.
Detective Bolera answered Machiq about how the curse affected people.
Akuma asked where the person he was speaking with was from.
Akuma commented on an accent slip and learning Varisian.
Akuma told the captain it was an honor to serve and that he should get rest.
Akuma saluted and left the room toward his bed.
The focus returned to the infirmary.
Consulting Detective Báyakan introduced himself as newly appointed to the team.
Akuma welcomed Báyakan and joked about not squishing him.
Nadya explained she was a kitsune who chose her appearance.
Akuma shared that his mother died to give him life and he did not know his father.
Nadya said they would see what the captain had for them tomorrow.
The party reported for duty and were ushered into Lavarsus's office.
Lavarsus assigned the party to investigate the missing persons reports.
Lavarsus ordered the party to start with the Minkaian Trade House in the Dockway.
Lavarsus told the party to get out of his office and find the Trade House near the Bazaar of Sails.
Akuma stepped out of the office.
Báyakan summarized the missing wizard Kemeneles, ice wine merchant, Jalmeri tourists and Minkaian stonemasons.
Changer said Korvosa was the primary external threat and the party was not an internal threat.
Changer said the Minkaian Trade House was 1.7 miles northeast and warned about Korvosan agents.
Changer announced additional personnel waiting at the Dockway entrance.
The party watched the heroes of Magnimar go past in a carriage from dockway to Naos.
The party arrived at the Dockway entrance and met a uniformed kobold.
Kitt jumped up and down and waved to get the party's attention.
Kitt introduced as Inspector Kitt of the Chaplains Unit.
Changer ordered the group onward to the trade house.
The party saw an unfinished Tian-Xia tower behind tall red walls.
Builders, guards, planners, cooks and labourers ran around yelling.
Nadya called out to the woman as Magniwatch.
A limestone gargoyle-like watcher moved through the crowd to join the party.
Báyakan flew to the woman's shoulder and showed his badge.
Ama Uomi introduced herself as project coordinator for the Lantern Lodge.
Ama Uomi said five Minkaian stonemasons vanished a few nights ago.
Ama Uomi said the kobold crew demanded back pay and threatened to collapse the support beams.
Kitt offered to help resolve the situation peacefully.
Ama Uomi reported the guarded front stairs had gone quiet.
Ama Uomi looked toward the marble steps marking the temple entrance.
Akuma started toward the stairs with his arms raised.
Nadya watched Akuma advance warily.
A voice from inside the building invited the party in and told them to watch their step.
The GM asked if Kitt spoke Draconic.
Akuma asked out of character what the kobolds said in Draconic.
Overheard two Draconic voices arguing about posts in fountain room, ceiling and offering hall
Báyakan reported the back near the flimsy parchment wall likely had fewer traps
Nadya voted for the back way and prioritized the missing people
Akuma asked Changer to offer surrender and looked for a climb point
Paper-and-lattice wall panels were within arm's reach
Changer walked up to the front doors
Party stood on top of the building while Changer stayed on ground level
Changer knocked on the front doors and ordered surrender in Magnimar's name
Received no answer
Party stood upon the 1st floor
Felt warm heat rising from the room below
Heard bubbling sound and rushing water
Akuma attempted to move into the building quietly to spot kobolds
Báyakan quietly followed Akuma
Kitt followed behind the others
Breached from the roof
Nadya was noisy during the breach
Saw a female kobold guarding a large water fountain holding a detonator switch
Saw the front entrance was rigged with traps they had avoided
Kobold threatened to boil everyone if they came closer
Felt boiling fountain water heating the room
Doopa put the detonator on the ground and gave her name.
The party learned the fountain would still explode.
Báyakan offered to attempt to disable the fountain trap.
Doopa said Rekarek was in the big room with the fox statues.
Doopa said Skerix was upstairs with the hostages.
Báyakan made four clean disconnects of the pressure plates.
Changer said the party was on the clock and must proceed.
Link agreed to proceed.
The party moved forward.
The party exited the fountain room east through the open-air garden walkway.
The party was ambushed with crossbow bolts.
Nadya was hit for 24 damage and left dying.
Changer healed Nadya and saved her life.
Both kobolds were knocked unconscious.
The party opened the door to Room 4.
The dart trap sprang and rained darts on Akuma.
Akuma was fully healed.
Natalia and Cackle entered the room and aided Akuma.
Nadya took 30 damage from a critical dart hit.
Báyakan disabled another dart tube.
Akuma fought defensively against the darts.
Cackle died after the dart trap hit him.
Anko jammed one of the dart pipes.
Changer clogged the final dart tube and disabled the trap.
Natalia introduced herself to the party.
Kitt started treating Akuma's wounds.
Changer broke down the dart trap for parts.
